description: 4 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-08-30 under road-to-governed-harness-evolution 2.4, wave 1 (3 inbound confusion edges, no corpus). Exemplars cover INGESTION — a binary document, image, or audio file read INTO Markdown so it can be worked with here. Near-misses are the three neighbours that named it, each of which WRITES or transforms a document rather than reading one in.

queries.q: extract this PDF into Markdown so I can read it in the repo
OCR this screenshot into text for me
transcribe this audio file so I can quote from it
wandle dieses Word-Dokument in Markdown um, damit ich es hier lesen kann
merge these three PDFs into one and split page 4 out
queries.note: writing and transforming PDFs, not reading one into Markdown → pdf-tools

queries.q: generate a docx from this template and fill in the fields
queries.note: authoring a Word document rather than extracting one → docx-authoring

queries.q: analyse this character image down to the smallest mole and diff it against the canon
queries.note: a semantic read of an image's content, not a format conversion → image-analyser

queries.q: convert this TypeScript file to JavaScript
queries.note: a 'convert' query whose input is source code, not a document format the converter handles

queries.q: write me a Markdown README for this package
queries.note: authoring Markdown from scratch; the word Markdown is present and nothing is being extracted → readme-writing
